payload.text:
Prove this Lean 4 theorem (source: FATE-M, difficulty: easy).

Informal statement:
For every positive integer n at least two, the ring of integers modulo n is a field if and only if n is prime.

Formal statement to prove:
theorem fatem_019_zmod_isField_iff_prime (n : ℕ) :
    IsField (ZMod n) ↔ Nat.Prime n

Each role chooses its next allowed action. Use search_lemmas and compiler tools when they resolve real uncertainty. Hand off only when the receiving role can act on concrete mathematical, compiler, or review evidence. A non-linear route is allowed, but extra communication is not itself success. The final proof must compile, preserve the exact statement, and contain no sorry, admit, or added axiom.

{"code":"import Mathlib

 theorem fatem_019_zmod_isField_iff_prime (n : ℕ) :
    IsField (ZMod n) ↔ Nat.Prime n := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    by_cases hn : n.Prime
    · exact hn
    · have hne : n ≠ 0 := by
        intro h0
        subst h0
        letI := h.toField
        have : (0 : ZMod 0) ≠ 1 := zero_ne_one
        simpa using this
      have hone : n ≠ 1 := by
        intro h1
        have hnt : ¬ Nontrivial (ZMod n) := by simpa [h1] using (ZMod.nontrivial_iff (n := n))
        exact hnt h.nontrivial
      have hmem : n.minFac ∈ n.primeFactors := Nat.minFac_mem_primeFactors hne hone
      have hprime : Nat.Prime n.minFac := Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hmem
      have hnotunit : ¬ IsUnit ((n.minFac : ℕ) : ZMod n) := ZMod.not_isUnit_of_mem_primeFactors hmem
      have hz : ((n.minFac : ℕ) : ZMod n) ≠ 0 := by
        intro hz0
        have hdiv : n ∣ n.minFac := (ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff (n.minFac) n).mp hz0
        exact hn (Nat.prime_def_minFac.mpr ⟨hone, ?_⟩)
      letI := h.toField
      exact False.elim (hnotunit (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hz))
  · intro h
    letI : Fact (Nat.Prime n) := ⟨h⟩
    letI : Field (ZMod n) := ZMod.instField n
    exact Field.toIsField (ZMod n)
"}
